decisions.reason: As a publicly presented flagship close to the core offer and central to the announced digital direction, the firm is likely to persist despite any disappointing results.
The continuing education institute builds on established training resources and represents sunk investment, so the firm is likely to keep it even with limited visibility.
The remote screen sharing support tool fits with existing support services and has incurred investment, making the firm reluctant to drop it under escalation of commitment.
The practice performance analytics dashboard builds on the established offer and aligns with innovation goals, so early withdrawal is unlikely.
The complete dental practice bundle is close to the established offer and was prominently presented, so sunk costs and public commitment make dropping unlikely.
As a distant, low-visibility listing portal with weaker commitment and less centrality to the firm's announced direction, disappointing results more likely lead to dropping.
